name: Anarch Thaumaturgical Rituals — 2 Intermediate — Hell's Calling

system.description: By burning a target's personal item over an iron brazier during a 30-minute casting, the ritualist forces that person into a supernatural panic identical to @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.rules-reference.JournalEntry.7f69a74f36db4a08]{Rotschreck}, regardless of what the target was doing or whether fire is actually present. The victim may resist with the usual Willpower or Courage/Self-Control test; on failure, he flees screaming and knocks aside anyone in his path, with no clue as to what frightened him. Unlike ordinary Rotschreck, the fear subsides immediately once the victim leaves the environment where it struck, though he retains no explanation for his terror.
system.duration: Until the victim leaves the triggering environment
